Reflection

Reflection

During The Consumer Journey module, I have acquired various employability skills that have enhanced my confidence and readiness to become a marketer and business person in the future. Group projects made me have to work with other people, distribute roles and express my ideas. The collaboration helped me to understand that it is necessary to listen to various opinions, solve issues in a professional manner, and make a contribution to common goals. These experiences helped me to develop teamwork, communication, and problem solving skills.

The MO:DE Festival experience was especially useful in enhancing my career awareness. The work with the representatives of the industry and studying the latest trends in the creative field has enabled me to get to know how the marketing theory is put into practice. This experience made me realize the need to develop professional networks and the necessity to keep learning in a fast-changing industry. Moreover, making presentations and doing independent research enhanced my digital literacy, time management, and prioritisation of multiple academic assignments and deadline-meeting.

An important issue of my academic growth was the ability to enhance the accuracy of my words and the order of my arguments. Kalaitsidou and Tin (2026) indicate that lexical semantics is concerned with correct application of terms whereas logical semantics is concerned with logical thinking and significant associations among concepts. I gained confidence in terms of using the correct marketing terminology, as well as to provide evidence logically and properly structured, throughout this module. These enhancements boosted my written work as well as oral presentation so that I could express myself more professionally.

On the whole, this module has not only improved my academic skills, but also my professional preparedness. Teamwork, industry participation, self-directed learning and communication skills have helped me to be ready to work in the future in marketing and consumer-oriented organisations. I am aware that employability is a lifelong learning and self-development and I will ensure that I enhance these competencies as I progress in my studies and beyond the college.

Academic Development

Throughout the module I improved the accuracy of my marketing terminology and strengthened the logical organisation of my ideas when presenting evidence and supporting decisions. These improvements enhanced both my academic communication and professional confidence.
